description: This file is a PHP class defining the PaymentMethod controller for the checkout process in the OpenCart project. It contains methods for rendering the payment method selection, handling AJAX requests for saving payment data, and managing user agreements during checkout.

classes.name: PaymentMethod
classes.description: Controller class managing payment method selection and processing during checkout.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the payment method selection page, populating data with selected payment method, code, and other checkout info.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to retrieve available payment methods based on the current cart and checkout state.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the AJAX request to save the selected payment method along with any comments, updating the order accordingly.

methods.name: comment
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to add or update a comment on the order during checkout.

methods.name: agree
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to record user agreement to terms and conditions.
